title: just-deliver catalog naming rules
description: How name(<kind>) builds a resource name. Files of this kind are merged; a resource kind may be ruled only once.

rules.description: Resource kind (the argument of name()) -> rule.

pattern.description: Name template. Placeholders: {workload} workload name, {id} requirement id, {env} environment name, {hash} short deterministic hash used to keep the name within maxLength and unique.

allowed.description: Regex character class of legal characters, for example [a-z0-9-].
